title: SlaValidation
description: SLA validation details for data contract.

refreshFrequencyMet.description: Whether refresh frequency requirement was met.

lastRefreshedAt.description: When the data was last refreshed, as far as OpenMetadata can tell. Absent when no source records it.

refreshedAtSource.description: Where the last refresh time comes from: the latest profile of the SLA column (its newest value), the table's system metrics (its latest write), or its life cycle (its last update).

message.description: Which SLA requirements were missed, and which could not be evaluated and why.
